purpose: Document a predetermined COCO val2017 comparison subset excluding all documented published phone-v2 train/development image IDs and exact image bytes. No inference or candidate selection is performed.
candidate_final_test_not_started: Reported by supervising agent before this task; candidate outputs were not opened by this audit.

old_phone_v2_dataset_manifest.contains_private_rows: Local provenance only; no private rows are reproduced in this receipt.

official_coco_val_images.canonical_pairs_encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON of [[integer_image_id, lowercase_image_sha256], ...], sorted by image ID, no trailing newline

exclusion_policy.rule: Exclude a val2017 image if its integer image ID appears in any COCO old train/dev row OR its file SHA256 appears in any old train/dev row, including private rows. Retain all other official val2017 images; no selection by predictions, model scores or outcomes.

mapping_verification.original_manifest_image_paths: Original Windows training-server paths are retained. This audit maps using explicit coco_id/source_split and verifies local original val image bytes against saved SHA256; it does not depend on those original paths being mounted.
not_checked: Any undocumented upstream evaluation or tuning exposure

canonical_clean_ids.encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON integer array sorted ascending; json.dumps(ids, separators=(comma, colon)); no trailing newline

allowed_interpretation: Independent of documented old phone-v2 fine-tune train/development exposure by exact COCO image ID and image bytes.

Phone comparison supports false-positive counts and negative-image false-positive rate only. There are zero phone-positive images, so phone recall, phone AP and overall phone superiority cannot be established from this subset.

Person scoring or comparison requires the generic pretrained person-capable baseline; the published phone-v2 model has no person class. The pinned YOLO11n initializer is recorded in training/provenance/pretrained-models.json.
This is pre-candidate-final-test split documentation. No inference, heldout candidate result review, checkpoint selection or operating-threshold tuning occurred.

This subset does not replace the candidate full official COCO final image gates and does not establish temporal/event accuracy, physical webcam acceptance, photographing intent or full system acceptance.

publication_redaction.embedded_evidence_hashes_scope: historical original artifacts; a redacted report copy has a different file hash
